laboderie1608.summary: A report from England on negotiations in the Low Countries, expressing concern about placing too much hope in one course of action.
laboderie1608.en:
George Lasry, report PDF 45francais-3516-la-boderie-f59r60v.pdf, "Excerpt and Translation".

Quite ill-founded, so that I am far from expecting any good from this godparent relationship. I fear that it will produce only contempt on both sides, and on both sides it seems that people are merely going through the motions.
